data.name: Mohanraj
data.gender_notes: Mohanraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mohanraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'mohana' (delight) and 'raj' (rule). The name Mohanraj signifies the one who delights the gods and rules over their hearts. This name is often given to children who are believed to have the potential to bring happiness and joy to those around them. The name Mohanraj carries the meaning “Delight of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mohanraj usually hope their child will grow to embody delight of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mohanraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mohanraj total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
